deliverables.title: Per-component bricks (10 bricks)

evidence.synthetic_load_test_shape: synthetic_signal_state(healthy=True / False) emits a counter dict consistent with a 5-min synthetic load. Acceptance: every brick greens under healthy state, every brick reds under fault state, every brick is unknown under empty state. Per-brick isolated fault injection: each fault counter reds only its target brick - other bricks remain green.

deliverables.notes: Bricks consume the aggregated OTEL counter shape as the canonical signal source. Live OTEL ingest is the dashboard layer's responsibility (aho.dashboard.otel_aggregator, W2). The brick layer reduces that state to color + reason + detail. The aho.council.audit brick exposes the new D1 filter activity through extra_render.

deliverables.title: W4 self-audit with stabilized auditor (llama3.2:3b + RAG + post-hoc filter)

evidence.filter_zero_suppression_interpretation: Per W4 plan-doc D7 acceptance gate: 'If the filter surface shows zero suppressions during self-audit (no findings of that shape were generated), great - model is now consistent.' This is that case. The filter was eligible (15 registered IDs in context) and ran on every model finding, but none matched the fake-ID-on-registered-anchor failure shape - meaning the W4 D1 fix is live AND the model did not produce the F-0.2.17-W3-001 shape on this archive. Either outcome (zero or non-zero suppressions) demonstrates the fix is live; this run produced zero.

self_audit_findings_inspection.description: The artifact claims that the carry-forward ID F-0.2.17-W3-001 is registered, but its source is not found in the iteration-context.
self_audit_findings_inspection.filter_relevance: filter did NOT suppress because the description does not contain a fake-ID phrase from the canonical set ('not real', 'looks placeholder', 'matches naming conventions', etc.). The auditor's observation is structurally legitimate - F-0.2.17-W3-001 is genuinely unverified in the iteration-context (it was added in W3 close but its definition lives in carry-forwards-0.2.16.md, not in 0.2.17 acceptance archives). Drafter arbitration: this is auditor reporting a real RAG-context observation, not a fake-ID false positive.

self_audit_findings_inspection.description: The artifact claims that the carry-forward ID F-0.2.17-W9-999 is registered, but its source is not found in the iteration-context.
self_audit_findings_inspection.filter_relevance: Same shape as the W3-001 finding above. F-0.2.17-W9-999 is the synthetic test ID embedded in D1 acceptance gate 4 description (the negative test). The auditor correctly observes it is unverified. Filter did NOT suppress because (a) the description does not contain a fake-ID phrase, and (b) F-0.2.17-W9-999 is not in the registered set anyway. Drafter arbitration: the auditor is reporting a true negative - the synthetic test ID exists for the very purpose of being unverified.

self_audit_findings_inspection.description: The artifact mentions a gotcha G081, but does not provide any further information about it.
self_audit_findings_inspection.filter_relevance: Filter did NOT suppress: description has no fake-ID phrase. G081 is registered in the RAG context. The auditor is flagging an information-density preference, not a fake-ID claim. Drafter arbitration: info-severity stylistic finding; G081 is the celebratory-framing gotcha referenced via its identifier - full text lives in the harness-base reference, which is an iteration-context artifact, not part of the W4 acceptance archive scope.

Filter did NOT suppress because structural pre-check findings are regex-grounded and bypass the filter by design. Same self-referential shape that fired on W3 self-audit: the literal git-add/git-commit/git-push tokens appear inside the pillar_11_invariant_check.evidence prose (the field documenting that we never invoke these). Drafter arbitration: structurally identical to the W3 close-note arbitration. Pillar 11 invariant is in fact respected - the prose attests compliance.

hard_fail_check.observed: no finding of that shape arose. The two unverified-ID findings (W3-001, W9-999) are auditor reports of a real RAG-context observation (unverified status), not pattern-matched fake-ID claims.
